Vintage Textile Mill Bobbins
Wood Bobbin & Paper Pirn Tubes
5 Items, Mid-20th Century
This lot of five vintage textile mill bobbins includes one turned hardwood bobbin and four composite paper pirn tubes with protective metal ferrules. Originating from commercial textile manufacturing, these pieces retain authentic maker stamps and working patina, bundled with a decorative plaid fabric wrap.
ITEMS INCLUDED:

Hardwood Bobbin

American Paper Tube Co. Quill

Textube Green Tube
- Stamped markings with green grid pattern and metal ferrule
4.
Textube Striped Tube
- Striped paper pirn with metal ferrule
5.
Textube 286 Tube
- Stamped "TEXTUBE 286" with metal end ferrule
Condition:
Vintage industrial condition with expected signs of mill use. Turned wood bobbin shows surface patina and minor handling marks. Paper composite tubes exhibit light edge wear, surface darkening, and natural metal oxidation on ferrules. All pieces are structurally intact.

Description
: Enhance your collectibles or crystal collection with this diverse lot of assorted gemstones and minerals. Inside, you'll find a vibrant variety of tumbled stones, rough minerals, crystal points, and decorative wrapped pendants, as pictured. The highlighted pieces include a tall rose quartz point and a slender clear quartz or selenite tower, along with polished stones in shades of blue, green, purple, brown, and red, plus unique copper and wire-wrapped pendants for added character. This substantial mixed lot offers a visually appealing array of gemstones, ranging from polished cabochons to natural/raw mineral specimens of different shapes and sizes, making it suitable for display, crafting, or personal enjoyment. Each stone or crystal features distinctive natural patterns, colors, and visible imperfections, reflecting its authentic origins and past handling. No two pieces are identical, providing true variety for hobbyists or anyone interested in geology and mineralogy. Stones show typical surface marks and some chipped edges, consistent with regular use and handling
